## 1. Scheme Information

*Id*:
65

*Scheme Code*:
mahadbt-baksy

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring
5. Electricity Connection
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)
9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

*Main Component*:

*Sub Component*:

*Introduction*:
Tribal Sub-Plan (In-Area and Outside-Area) is being implemented since 1992-93 to increase the income of Scheduled Tribe farmers and improve their standard of living. Considering the needs of the farmers in the changed situation, as per the Government administrative approval Ref/letter No. Auyo 2416/Pr.No.177/4A, dated 9/8/2017. to revise the said scheme from the year 2017-18 vide Government Decision Also, the Government has decided to implement the said scheme under the name Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana (Inside-Area and Outside-Area).
Also, the Government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the Government decision dated 01 October, 2024.

*Introduction*:
The Central Government has issued Operational Guidelines in the year 2024 for implementing the Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Per Drop More Crop, a centrally sponsored micro-irrigation scheme. This scheme is being implemented from the year 2022-23 under the name Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana - Per Drop More Crop. The Commissionerate of Agriculture, has issued guidelines for the micro-irrigation scheme. On the lines of this scheme, a micro-irrigation scheme (Drip and Sprinkler Irrigation) will be implemented under the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Project. Accordingly, the following guidelines are being issued for implementing the approved micro-irrigation component in the villages selected under the project.

*Benefits*:
1.To increase the area under micro-irrigation by using modern technology in the project districts and to promote climate-resilient farming practices.
2. To encourage micro-irrigation methods for the development of agriculture and horticulture crops based on modern technology.
3. To manage fertilizers through the micro-irrigation system.
4. To increase agricultural production, the quality of agricultural produce, and consequently, the total income of farmers.
5. To increase water use efficiency.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have already received benefits on same land from any other scheme will not be eligible under this scheme.
2. If the farmer has availed the benefits of micro-irrigation components under any government scheme in the last 7 years, such areas will be excluded, and the remaining area can receive benefits within the total limit of 5 hectares.
3. The farmer must have access to water supply and electricity.
4. The benefits of this component under the project will be available to beneficiaries who own up to 5 hectares of land.

*Required Documents*:
1. If the applicant belongs to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category, a caste certificate should be provided.
2. If the applicant is a joint account holder, a consent letter from the other account holders shall be submitted.
3. If the applicant is a person with disability, a disability certificate should be provided.

*Application Process*:
The NDKSP DBT Portal has been created with the following objectives - 
DBT System for accepting and processing subsidy applications received from farmers. Through this system, farmers can directly login and apply for financial assistance under scheme and disbursement of funds happen directly to the Aadhaar linked account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. There is no need for farmer to visit a government office to apply for subsidy or receive disbursed funds. Also, farmers can track and monitor their applications in real time which shows transparency in NDKSP operations. This system facilitates NDKSP to perform its approval process in 100% paperless manner which eliminates intermediaries and establishes credibility. 
To avail the benefits of the components under the project, the beneficiary (farmer) must directly login on the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system using their Farmer ID. After login, the beneficiary becomes eligible to receive the project benefits. Additionally, it is mandatory for the beneficiary to link their Aadhaar number with their bank account so that the benefit amount can be directly transferred to their personal bank account.
The following farmer attributes need to be entered in the Portal: 
Farmer Attributes: (Essential): 
State, District, Sub-District/Block, Village, Farmer Name, Type of Identity  Farmer ID for landholder farmer is essential, Gender, Category, land cosent letter for joint landholders.

Step 1: Farmer Login and Application Process through the "Mahavistaar-AI Application"
a) First, download and install the "Mahavistaar-AI Application" from the "Google Play Store" on your mobile.
b) After entering the application, enter your registered Farmer ID.

d) Upon clicking, click the "NDKSP (PoCRA)" tab.

f) Following this, your NDKSP (PoCRA) project dashboard screen will be available.
g) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.

a) Visit to "https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications" NDKSP 2.0 website
b) After entering the webpage of Farmer login, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, dashboard screen will be available.
d) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.

*Introduction*:
Most of the dryland farming in the state is dependent on rainfall, and regions like Marathwada, Vidarbha, and East Vidarbha frequently experience low rainfall, uneven distribution, and long dry spells. Due to the lack of irrigation, there is a significant reduction in crop production, and sometimes crops are completely lost, leading to financial losses for farmers. On the other hand, when it rains heavily, runoff water flows through streams and nullahs and goes to waste. As a sustainable solution to this problem, it is very important to store the runoff rainwater in farm ponds and use it for protective irrigation. However, to retain the stored water for a longer period and to prevent wastage of water, lining of the farm ponds is necessary. Farm pond lining prevents water seepage, helps in retaining water, and allows farmers to use it for agriculture as needed. This increases productivity, averts financial losses, and makes farming more sustainable. Therefore, the farm pond lining component is being implemented under this project.

*Main Component*:

*Sub Component*:
1. Vermicompost Production Unit 
2. NADEP Compost Production Unit

*Introduction*:
Under the organic farming system, conserving nature, reducing crop production costs, and increasing the use of alternative organic and biological inputs for hazardous chemicals like chemical fertilizers, pesticides, herbicides, and hormones is the need of the hour. Vermicompost is made from farm waste, plant-based materials, and cow dung by earthworms. Vermicompost contains various bacteria, enzymes, vitamins, and other useful chemicals, which have a positive effect on plant growth. 
Similarly, processing farm waste through composting results in the decomposition of its organic matter through biological methods by microorganisms and earthworms, producing excellent humus-like organic compost. If this compost is used extensively in the fields, it will significantly improve soil health and greatly boost agricultural production. It is the need of the hour to prepare organic manure from all plant-based materials generated in the field and return it to the field. Organic manure improves soil texture and water retention capacity, ensuring an adequate supply of nutrients. The soil remains friable, which keeps it aerated. It helps in the growth of beneficial microorganisms in the farm. 
In this regard, considering the above matter, it is proposed to implement the Vermicompost Production Unit and NADEP Compost Production Unit as individual benefit components.

*Benefits*:
1.To enable small and marginal farmers in the village clusters included in the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp to adapt to the situation arising from climate change.
2. To produce nutritious food grains.
3. To practice agriculture by making proper use of natural elements without harming them.
4. To increase soil fertility and maintain it for a long time.
5. To reuse local resources in agriculture.
6. To reduce the cost of agricultural production and increase the net income of the farmer.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have received benefits from any other scheme for this component will not receive benefits again under this scheme.

Afterwards, from the year 2022-23, NFSM (OS & OP) subsumed as National Mission On Edible Oil (NMEO) and till 2024-25, the following three missions were under this mission. 1) Mission No. 1: Oilseeds Crops 2) Mission No. 3: Tree Oilseeds Crops 3) TRFA (Oilseeds).

Risk covered -  Crop cutting base average yield reduction in comparison to threshhold yield for that insurance unit( Revenue circle)

1. The scheme is applicable for notified crops in a notified area (revenue circle). All farmers including share-croppers, tenant farmers growing notified crops in the notified area.
2. The scheme is optional for both loanee as well as non-loanee  farmers.
3. Under this scheme, the indemnity level is  fixed as 70 % for all notified crops.
4. Threshold yield  is determined by taking into account the average average yield  of the  best five years from past 7 years multiplied by  indemnity level
5. The scheme is implemented on beed pattern (80:110) where Insurance companies claim liability is up to 110 %  of the gross premium  or 110% of the burn cost whichever is higher for the given cluster in given season .  The claims above 110 % will be paid by state govt. and in case of profit, Insurance company will keep 20% of the gross premium and return the balance premium amount to state if any .

*Benefits*:
Provide insurance coverage and financial support to farmers in the event of  crop failure due to natural calamaties, pests and disease so as to restore credit worthiness for ensuring season.

*Eligibility*:
1. All the farmers  growing notified crops in the notified area are eligible.
2. The scheme is  optional for Loanee & Non-loanee farmers.

Sum insured per hector: Sum insured per hectare is decided as per scale of finance for that crop

Insurance Companies: The scheme is being implemented through selected  crop insurance companies  through tendering process.

*Required Documents*:
1. Agristack number
2. Aadhar card
3. Bank account details
4. Land details and crop details

question: मी नवीन शेतकरी आहे, कोणत्या योजना माझ्यासाठी सर्वप्रथम उपलब्ध आहेत?
answer:
आपल्या शेतीच्या अनुभवाचा आणि शेतीच्या आरंभाच्या दृष्टीने आपल्याला आवश्यक असलेल्या योजनांची माहिती आपल्याला येथे दिली आहे. आपण शेतकरी म्हणून नवीन असल्याने, आपल्या शेतीच्या विकासासाठी अनेक योजना आपल्याला उपलब्ध आहेत. या योजनांची तपशीलवार माहिती खालीलप्रमाणे आहे:

---

### 1. **डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजना (BAKSY)**  
**स्थानिक योजना (महाराष्ट्र)**

- **प्रमुख फायदे**:  
  - आपल्या शेतासाठी नवीन भागात बावटी तयार करणे, पुरातन बावटी दुरुस्त करणे, पाणी वाहतुकीचे नळ बसवणे, तापमान आणि विद्युत जोडणी इत्यादींसाठी सब्सिडी.  
  - डायजेस्ट आणि डिझेल पंपसेट, सोलर पंपसेट, बावटी लाइनिंग, फार्म पोन्ड लाइनिंग, ड्रिप आणि स्प्रिंकलर इरिगेशन यंत्रणा, शेती यंत्रे यांसाठी सब्सिडी उपलब्ध आहे.

- **पात्रता**:  
  - आपला जातीय वर्ग **ST (आदिवासी)** आहे.  
  - शेतीचे भूमी मर्यादा: **0.20 हे. ते 6.00 हे.**  
  - आपल्या शेताची जमीन असलेल्या विकासासाठी आपल्याला अर्ज करता येईल.

- **आवश्यक कागदपत्रे**:  
  - ST जातीचा दाखला  
  - 7/12 आणि 8A दस्तऐवज  
  - आधार कार्ड आणि आधार-बँक अकाउंट लिंक

- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया**:  
  - ऑनलाइन अर्ज: [https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in](https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in)  
  - आपल्या जिल्ह्यातील कृषी अधिकारी यांच्या तपासणीनंतर आपल्याला अर्ज मंजूर होईल.

---

### 2. **मुख्यमंत्री स्थिर कृषी सिंचन योजना – वैयक्तिक शेती पोन्ड (CMSAISFP)**  
**स्थानिक योजना (महाराष्ट्र)**

- **प्रमुख फायदे**:  
  - वैयक्तिक शेती पोन्ड तयार करण्यासाठी सब्सिडी.  
  - आपल्या शेताच्या पोन्डासाठी आपल्याला **14,433 ते 75,000 रुपये** एवढी सब्सिडी मिळू शकते.

- **पात्रता**:  
  - आपल्या शेताची जमीन **0.20 हे. (कोकण भागात)** आणि **0.40 हे. (इतर भागात)** असावी.  
  - आपल्या शेतात पाणी आणि विद्युत उपलब्ध असावी.

- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया**:  
  - ऑनलाइन अर्ज: [https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in](https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in)

---

### 3. **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प (NDKSP) – ड्रिप आणि स्प्रिंकलर इरिगेशन**  
**स्थानिक योजना (महाराष्ट्र)**

- **प्रमुख फायदे**:  
  - ड्रिप आणि स्प्रिंकलर इरिगेशन यंत्रणा बसवण्यासाठी सब्सिडी.  
  - आपल्या शेतात पाणी वापर वाढवणे आणि उत्पादन वाढवणे.

- **पात्रता**:  
  - आपल्या शेताची जमीन **5 हे. पर्यंत** असावी.  
  - आपल्या शेतात पाणी आणि विद्युत उपलब्ध असावी.  
  - या योजनेचा लाभ फक्त **PoCRA गावांमध्ये** मिळतो.  
  - आपले गाव **नाला, अक्कलकुवा, नंदुरबार** आहे. त्यामुळे या योजनेचा लाभ मिळू शकतो.

- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया**:  
  - ऑनलाइन अर्ज: [https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications](https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications)  
  - महाविस्तार-एआय अॅपद्वारे अर्ज करा.

---

### 4. **प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधी (PM-KISAN)**  
**केंद्रीय योजना**

- **प्रमुख फायदे**:  
  - वार्षिक **6,000 रुपये** (तीन तिमाहीत 2,000 रुपये) लाभ.  
  - शेतकरी कुटुंबाला योजनेचा लाभ मिळतो.

- **पात्रता**:  
  - शेती करणारे जमीनदार आणि शेतीचे जमीन असलेले लोक.

- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया**:  
  - ऑनलाइन अर्ज: [https://pmkisan.gov.in](https://pmkisan.gov.in)

---

### 5. **नामो शेतकरी महासम्मान निधी (NSMNY)**  
**केंद्रीय योजना**

- **प्रमुख फायदे**:  
  - PM-KISAN च्या लाभावर अतिरिक्त **6,000 रुपये वार्षिक** मिळतात.

- **पात्रता**:  
  - PM-KISAN चा लाभ घेणारे शेतकरी.

- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया**:  
  - कोणताही अर्ज लागत नाही. PM-KISAN चा लाभ घेणारे लोक ऑटोमॅटिक लाभ घेतात.

---

### 6. **प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा योजना (PMFBY)**  
**केंद्रीय योजना**

- **प्रमुख फायदे**:  
  - फसल नष्ट झाल्यास आपल्याला आर्थिक मदत मिळते.

- **पात्रता**:  
  - नियोजित शेतीच्या भागात नियोजित पिके लावलेले शेतकरी.

- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया**:  
  - ऑनलाइन अर्ज: [https://pmfby.gov.in](https://pmfby.gov.in)

---

### 7. **कृषी अवकाश फंड (AIF)**  
**केंद्रीय योजना**

- **प्रमुख फायदे**:  
  - शेतीच्या पोस्ट-हार्वेस्ट अवकाशासाठी बँक ऋणासाठी **3% व्याज सब्सिडी** आणि **क्रेडिट गारंटी कव्हर**.

- **पात्रता**:  
  - शेतीच्या पोस्ट-हार्वेस्ट अवकाशासाठी ऋण घेणारे शेतकरी.

---

### ✅ आपल्यासाठी अनुशंसित योजना:

चूक न करता, आपल्या शेतीच्या विकासासाठी खालील योजनांचा लाभ घ्या:

1. **BAKSY** – आपल्या शेतासाठी पाणी सिंचन यंत्रणा आणि बावटी बसवण्यासाठी.  
2. **CMSAISFP** – वैयक्तिक शेती पोन्ड बसवण्यासाठी.  
3. **NDKSP – ड्रिप इरिगेशन** – पाणी वाचवण्यासाठी आणि उत्पादन वाढवण्यासाठी.  
4. **PM-KISAN आणि NSMNY** – वार्षिक आर्थिक मदत मिळवण्यासाठी.

---

### 📌 सूचना:
- आपल्या गावातील **PoCRA योजना** चा लाभ मिळतो का? याची तपासणी आपल्या स्थानिक कृषी अधिकारी कडून करा.  
- आपल्या शेताच्या जमीनीची नोंद करा आणि आपल्या आधार कार्ड आणि बँक खाते लिंक करा.

---

### 📞 आपल्या मदतीसाठी संपर्क:
- **स्थानिक कृषी अधिकारी**: आपल्या गावातील अग्रिम कृषी अधिकारी कडून अधिक माहिती मिळवा.  
- **महाविस्तार-एआय अॅप**: आपल्या शेतीच्या आरंभासाठी अनेक गाईडलाइन्स आणि अर्ज प्रक्रिया उपलब्ध आहेत.

---

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**  
आपल्या शेतीच्या विकासासाठी आपण या योजनांचा लाभ घेऊ शकता. आपल्या शेतीच्या यशासाठी आपल्या विचारांची आणि विकासाची आणखी मदत हवी असल्यास, आपण आम्हाला विचारू शकता.

*Introduction*:
The Central Government has issued Operational Guidelines in the year 2024 for implementing the Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Per Drop More Crop, a centrally sponsored micro-irrigation scheme. This scheme is being implemented from the year 2022-23 under the name Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana - Per Drop More Crop. The Commissionerate of Agriculture, has issued guidelines for the micro-irrigation scheme. On the lines of this scheme, a micro-irrigation scheme (Drip and Sprinkler Irrigation) will be implemented under the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Project. Accordingly, the following guidelines are being issued for implementing the approved micro-irrigation component in the villages selected under the project.

*Benefits*:
1.To increase the area under micro-irrigation by using modern technology in the project districts and to promote climate-resilient farming practices.
2. To encourage micro-irrigation methods for the development of agriculture and horticulture crops based on modern technology.
3. To manage fertilizers through the micro-irrigation system.
4. To increase agricultural production, the quality of agricultural produce, and consequently, the total income of farmers.
5. To increase water use efficiency.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have already received benefits on same land from any other scheme will not be eligible under this scheme.
2. If the farmer has availed the benefits of micro-irrigation components under any government scheme in the last 7 years, such areas will be excluded, and the remaining area can receive benefits within the total limit of 5 hectares.
3. The farmer must have access to water supply and electricity.
4. The benefits of this component under the project will be available to beneficiaries who own up to 5 hectares of land.

*Required Documents*:
1. If the applicant belongs to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category, a caste certificate should be provided.
2. If the applicant is a joint account holder, a consent letter from the other account holders shall be submitted.
3. If the applicant is a person with disability, a disability certificate should be provided.

*Application Process*:
The NDKSP DBT Portal has been created with the following objectives - 
DBT System for accepting and processing subsidy applications received from farmers. Through this system, farmers can directly login and apply for financial assistance under scheme and disbursement of funds happen directly to the Aadhaar linked account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. There is no need for farmer to visit a government office to apply for subsidy or receive disbursed funds. Also, farmers can track and monitor their applications in real time which shows transparency in NDKSP operations. This system facilitates NDKSP to perform its approval process in 100% paperless manner which eliminates intermediaries and establishes credibility. 
To avail the benefits of the components under the project, the beneficiary (farmer) must directly login on the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system using their Farmer ID. After login, the beneficiary becomes eligible to receive the project benefits. Additionally, it is mandatory for the beneficiary to link their Aadhaar number with their bank account so that the benefit amount can be directly transferred to their personal bank account.
The following farmer attributes need to be entered in the Portal: 
Farmer Attributes: (Essential): 
State, District, Sub-District/Block, Village, Farmer Name, Type of Identity  Farmer ID for landholder farmer is essential, Gender, Category, land cosent letter for joint landholders. 
Farmer Login and application Module:
Step 1: Farmer Login and Application Process through the "Mahavistaar-AI Application"
a) First, download and install the "Mahavistaar-AI Application" from the "Google Play Store" on your mobile.
b) After entering the application, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, click the "DBT" tab at the bottom right of the Dashboard screen.
d) Upon clicking, click the "NDKSP (PoCRA)" tab.
e) To avail benefits for various items under individual components, click the "Click Here" link at the end of this screen to apply.
f) Following this, your NDKSP (PoCRA) project dashboard screen will be available.
g) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.
Step 2: Farmer Login and application Process through the "Project's DBT Web Portal"
a) Visit to "https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications" NDKSP 2.0 website
b) After entering the webpage of Farmer login, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, dashboard screen will be available.
d) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.

https://mahapocra.gov.in/documents/Micro_Irrigation_Guideline_NDKSP_2.0.pdf

Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Main Component*:
Individual Farm Ponds

*Sub Component*:
1. Farm Pond With Inlet Outlet
2. Farm Pond Without Inlet Outlet

*Introduction*:
82% of the agriculture in the state is rainfed, and uneven distribution and uncertain breaks in rainfall are major problems. Due to the lack of irrigation, crop production decreases, or sometimes crops are destroyed, leading to financial losses for farmers. As a solution, it is necessary to construct farm ponds to store excess water flowing through streams, rivulets, and rivers during the monsoon to create a facility for protective irrigation. Considering the current drought-like situation in the state, the implementation of the individual farm pond component is proposed under the World Bank-aided Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp to make protective irrigation facilities available to farmers.

*Benefits*:
1. To empower small and marginal farmers in the villages selected under the project to adapt to the situation arising from climate change. 
2. To create a facility for protective irrigation. 
3. To increase the area under a second crop and to increase the farmer's income. 
4. To encourage supplementary farming activities like horticulture, vegetable crops, pisciculture, orchards, and animal husbandry through farm ponds. 
5. To contribute to improving the groundwater level by conserving water resources.

*Eligibility*:
1. The farmer should have minimum 0.60 hectares of land in their own name.
2. It is necessary for a suitable location to be available according to technical specifications for the selected size of the pond.
3. The responsibility for obtaining the necessary machinery for completing the pond will rest with the respective beneficiary, and no advance amount will be provided for this purpose.
4. Compensation for damage will not be allowed if any harm occurs to the pond due to natural disasters.
5. Farmers who have received benefits from any other scheme for this component will not receive benefits under this scheme again.
6. It is necessary for a suitable location to be available according to technical specifications for the selected size of the pond.

*Main Component*:
Farm Pond Lining

*Sub Component*:
Farm Pond Lining

*Introduction*:
Most of the dryland farming in the state is dependent on rainfall, and regions like Marathwada, Vidarbha, and East Vidarbha frequently experience low rainfall, uneven distribution, and long dry spells. Due to the lack of irrigation, there is a significant reduction in crop production, and sometimes crops are completely lost, leading to financial losses for farmers. On the other hand, when it rains heavily, runoff water flows through streams and nullahs and goes to waste. As a sustainable solution to this problem, it is very important to store the runoff rainwater in farm ponds and use it for protective irrigation. However, to retain the stored water for a longer period and to prevent wastage of water, lining of the farm ponds is necessary. Farm pond lining prevents water seepage, helps in retaining water, and allows farmers to use it for agriculture as needed. This increases productivity, averts financial losses, and makes farming more sustainable. Therefore, the farm pond lining component is being implemented under this project.

*Benefits*:
1. To empower small and marginal farmers in the villages selected under the project to adapt to the situation arising from climate change. 
2. To create a facility for protective irrigation, increase the area under a second crop, and increase the farmer's income. 
3. To encourage supplementary farming activities like horticulture, vegetable crops, pisciculture, orchards, and animal husbandry through farm ponds.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have received benefits from any other scheme for this component will not receive benefits under this scheme again.
2. If the farmer has constructed a pond without inlets and outlets according to size from any other government scheme, they will be eligible for the lining component.
3. The benefits of this component under the project will be available to beneficiaries who own up to 5 hectares of land.
4. Compensation for damage will not be allowed if any harm occurs to the pond due to natural disasters.

*Main Component*:
Organic Production Unit

*Sub Component*:
1. Vermicompost Production Unit 
2. NADEP Compost Production Unit

*Introduction*:
Under the organic farming system, conserving nature, reducing crop production costs, and increasing the use of alternative organic and biological inputs for hazardous chemicals like chemical fertilizers, pesticides, herbicides, and hormones is the need of the hour. Vermicompost is made from farm waste, plant-based materials, and cow dung by earthworms. Vermicompost contains various bacteria, enzymes, vitamins, and other useful chemicals, which have a positive effect on plant growth. 
Similarly, processing farm waste through composting results in the decomposition of its organic matter through biological methods by microorganisms and earthworms, producing excellent humus-like organic compost. If this compost is used extensively in the fields, it will significantly improve soil health and greatly boost agricultural production. It is the need of the hour to prepare organic manure from all plant-based materials generated in the field and return it to the field. Organic manure improves soil texture and water retention capacity, ensuring an adequate supply of nutrients. The soil remains friable, which keeps it aerated. It helps in the growth of beneficial microorganisms in the farm. 
In this regard, considering the above matter, it is proposed to implement the Vermicompost Production Unit and NADEP Compost Production Unit as individual benefit components.

*Benefits*:
1.To enable small and marginal farmers in the village clusters included in the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp to adapt to the situation arising from climate change.
2. To produce nutritious food grains.
3. To practice agriculture by making proper use of natural elements without harming them.
4. To increase soil fertility and maintain it for a long time.
5. To reuse local resources in agriculture.
6. To reduce the cost of agricultural production and increase the net income of the farmer.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have received benefits from any other scheme for this component will not receive benefits again under this scheme.

question: मी सोयाबीन आणि कापूस दोन्ही पिकतो, कोणत्या योजनेत अर्ज करणे फायदेशीर आहे?
answer:
**सर्वात फायदेशीर योजना सूची**

आपल्या शेतीच्या विषयी जाणून घेऊन, आपल्या जिल्ह्याच्या विशेष आवश्यकतांनुसार आपल्यासाठी सर्वात योग्य असलेल्या योजना खालीलप्रमाणे आहेत:

---

### 1. **डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजना (BAKSY)**  
**स्थानिक योजना (राज्य स्तरावर)**

- **फायदे**:  
  - नवीन शेती तलावासाठी अधिकतम ₹4,00,000 पर्यंत आर्थिक मदत.  
  - जुन्या तलावाच्या दुरुस्तीसाठी ₹1,00,000 पर्यंत सब्सिडी.  
  - ड्रिप आणि स्प्रिंकलर इरिगेशनसाठी अतिरिक्त सब्सिडी (साठी ₹97,000 अथवा ₹47,000 विशिष्ट शेतीच्या प्रकारानुसार).  
  - शेतीच्या उपकरणांसाठी ₹50,000 पर्यंत सब्सिडी.  

- **पात्रता**:  
  - आपण आदिवासी (ST) वर्गातील आहात.  
  - शेतीची पाने 0.20 हेक्टर ते 6.00 हेक्टर असावीत.  
  - आपल्या शेतावर आपण शेती करत आहात.  

- **आवश्यक कागदपत्रे**:  
  - ST जातीचा दाखला  
  - 7/12 आणि 8A प्रमाणपत्र  
  - आधार आणि बँक खाते लिंक केलेले असावे  

- **अर्ज कसा करावा**:  
  - ऑनलाइन अर्ज करा: [https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login](https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login)  
  - अर्ज फायनल झाल्यानंतर अधिकृत अधिकारी आपल्या शेतावर तपासणी करतील.

> ✅ **आपल्यासाठी अत्यंत उपयुक्त योजना** – आपल्या शेतीच्या आकाराने आणि आदिवासी वर्गाच्या आवश्यकतांनुसार योजना अत्यंत योग्य आहे.

---

### 2. **नामो शेतकरी महासम्मान निधी (NSMNY)**  
**केंद्र स्तरावरील योजना**

- **फायदे**:  
  - आपण PM-KISAN योजनेत अर्ज केला असल्यास, त्याच्या बरोबर आपल्याला **वार्षिक ₹6,000** अतिरिक्त मदत मिळेल.  
  - ती तीन भागांमध्ये दिली जाते (प्रत्येकी ₹2,000).  

- **पात्रता**:  
  - PM-KISAN योजनेत अर्ज केलेले शेतकरी.  

- **अर्ज कसा करावा**:  
  - अर्ज करण्याची गरज नाही. जर आपण PM-KISAN योजनेत अर्ज केला असेल, तर NSMNY ची मदत स्वतःच दिली जाते.

> ✅ **सर्वात सोपी आणि वेगवान मदत** – आपण जर PM-KISAN मध्ये अर्ज केला असेल, तर आपल्याला अतिरिक्त लाभ मिळेल.

---

### 3. **प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधी (PM-KISAN)**  
**केंद्र स्तरावरील योजना**

- **फायदे**:  
  - वार्षिक ₹6,000 (तीन भागांमध्ये) शेतकरी कुटुंबाला दिले जाते.  

- **पात्रता**:  
  - 1 हेक्टर ते 10 हेक्टर शेतीचे मालक.  
  - आधार, 7/12, बँक खाते आणि ई-केव्हीसी लिंक केलेले असावे.  

- **अर्ज कसा करावा**:  
  - ऑनलाइन: [https://pmkisan.gov.in](https://pmkisan.gov.in)

> ✅ **पात्र असल्यास तत्काळ अर्ज करा** – या योजनेचा लाभ घेण्यासाठी आपल्याला फक्त एक अर्ज करावा लागतो.

---

### 4. **राष्ट्रीय खाद्य सुरक्षा आणि पोषण मिशन (NFSNM) – तेल बीज विकास योजना**  
**राज्य स्तरावरील योजना**

- **फायदे**:  
  - सोयाबीन, तेलगाळ, मूग आणि तांदूळ यांच्या शेतीत विशेष मदत.  
  - नवीन बीयांची खरेदी, बीयांची वितरण, आणि तेल उत्पादन यंत्रणांसाठी सब्सिडी.  
  - तेलगाळ आणि सोयाबीनच्या शेतीत उत्पादन वाढवण्यासाठी विशेष मदत.  

- **पात्रता**:  
  - आपल्या जिल्ह्यात योजना लागू आहे (नंदुरबार या योजनेत समाविष्ट आहे).  
  - शेतकरी समूह किंवा व्यक्तिगत शेतकरी.  

- **अर्ज कसा करावा**:  
  - ऑनलाइन: [https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in](https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in)

> ✅ **सोयाबीन आणि कापूस शेतीसाठी खास मदत** – या योजनेचा लाभ सोयाबीन शेतीसाठी अत्यंत उपयुक्त आहे.

---

### 5. **प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा योजना (PMFBY)**  
**केंद्र स्तरावरील योजना**

- **फायदे**:  
  - ज्यावर बाजार भाव घसरत आहेत किंवा बीमारी, अकाली बर्फ, अपघात यांमुळे फसल नष्ट झाली तर आर्थिक मदत मिळते.  
  - त्यात तुमच्या शेतीच्या फसलीच्या नुकसानीचा आर्थिक भाग भरला जातो.  

- **पात्रता**:  
  - नियोजित शेतीचे भागात शेती करणारे शेतकरी.

आपल्या शेतीच्या आकाराने (0.68 हेक्टर), आदिवासी वर्गातील असल्याने आणि सोयाबीन आणि कापूस शेती करत असल्याने **BAKSY** आणि **NSMNY** योजना आपल्यासाठी सर्वात फायदेशीर आहेत.

## 1. Scheme Information

*Id*:
65

*Scheme Code*:
mahadbt-baksy

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring
5. Electricity Connection
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)
9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

*Benefits*:

*Introduction*:
National Mission on Oilseed and Oil Palm (NMOOP) was launched by Government of India in year 2014-15. In 2018-19 GoI has merged NMOOP with NFSM as NFSM (OS&OP).  Afterwards, from the year 2022-23, NFSM (OS & OP) subsumed as National Mission On Edible Oil (NMEO) and till 2024-25, the following three missions were under this mission. 1) Mission No. 1: Oilseeds Crops 2) Mission No. 3: Tree Oilseeds Crops 3) TRFA (Oilseeds).
         The Central Government has approved a new Mission called National Mission on Edible Oil Oilseeds for the years 2024-25 to 2030-31. This has been done to promote the production of oilseed crops with primary focus on mustard, groundnut and soybean and to focus on secondary oilseeds and tree-borne oilseeds (TBO) along with other oilseed crops. Secondary Vegetable Oil Sub-mission is also part of the National Mission on Edible Oil Oilseeds (NMEO-OS) mission and has been included in it, which mainly includes oil extraction from secondary sources like cottonseed, rice bran and tree-borne oilseeds (TBO). Under this mission, 27 districts of Maharashtra have been selected for soybean, groundnut, safflower, mustard, Niger, sunflower and sesame. The mission will be implemented through Value Chain Cluster (VCC) and for this, a farmer producer company/cooperative/public or private organization will be selected as the Value Chain Partner (VCP) for each cluster. At the district level, the Value Chain Partners (VCPs) will be selected by the District Executive Committee (DEC).

**सेंद्रिय शेतीसाठी उपलब्ध योजना:**

आपल्या शेतीत सेंद्रिय पद्धतीचा वापर करण्यासाठी खालील शासकीय योजना उपलब्ध आहेत. या योजनांचा लाभ घेऊन तुम्ही शेतीत रासायनिक खतांच्या बदली सेंद्रिय खतांचा वापर करू शकता आणि शेतीची उत्पादकता वाढवू शकता.

### 1. **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प – सेंद्रिय उत्पादन एकक (NDKSP – Organic Production Unit)**  
**स्थानिक योजना (महाराष्ट्र राज्य)**

- **मुख्य फायदा**: वर्मीकॉम्पोस्ट आणि नाडेप कॉम्पोस्ट तयार करण्यासाठी आर्थिक सहाय्य.
- **सबसिडी**: योजनेत वर्मीकॉम्पोस्ट आणि नाडेप कॉम्पोस्ट तयार करण्यासाठी उपलब्ध आहे.
- **पात्रता**:  
  - शेतीची जमीन 5 हेक्टरपर्यंत असणे आवश्यक आहे.  
  - कमीत कमी दोन मोठ्या पशू (गाय, भैंस, बुलॉक) असणे आवश्यक आहे.  
  - ज्या शेतकऱ्यांना इतर योजनेत या घटकासाठी लाभ मिळाला आहे, त्यांना या योजनेचा लाभ दिला जाणार नाही.
- **आवश्यक कागदपत्रे**:  
  - दिव्यांग शेतकऱ्यांसाठी दिव्यांगत्व प्रमाणपत्र.  
  - आरक्षित वर्गाच्या शेतकऱ्यांसाठी आरक्षण प्रमाणपत्र.  
  - सामूहिक जमीन असल्यास इतर सहकारी शेतकऱ्यांचे सहमती पत्र.
- **अर्ज कसा करावा**:  
  - आपल्या फार्मर ID ने **महाविस्तार-एआय** अॅप किंवा **https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications** वर लॉगिन करा.  
  - "Apply for New Scheme" वर क्लिक करा आणि अर्ज पूर्ण करा.  
  - आधार आणि बँक खाते लिंक करणे आवश्यक आहे.
- **स्रोत**: [वर्मीकॉम्पोस्ट आणि नाडेप कॉम्पोस्ट तयार करण्याच्या मार्गदर्शक तत्त्वे](https://mahapocra.gov.in/documents/Vermicompost_and_NADEP_Compost_Production_Unit_Guidelines.pdf)  
  **स्रोत: नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प (NDKSP)**

---

### 2. **राष्ट्रीय कृषी विकास योजना (RKVY) – अंतिहेक्टरिल जाल आणि एमएस कोन्स्ट्रक्शन**  
**केंद्र सरकारची योजना**

- **मुख्य फायदा**: अंतिहेक्टरिल वादळांपासून पोमग्रेनेट वाटयांचे रक्षण करण्यासाठी जाल आणि लोखंडी रचना बांधण्यासाठी सबसिडी.
- **सबसिडी**: 50% आर्थिक सहाय्य (एकरी 2.12 लाख रुपये पर्यंत).
- **पात्रता**: पोमग्रेनेट शेती करणारे शेतकरी.
- **अर्ज कसा करावा**: [महाडीबीटी पोर्टल](https://mahectaredbt.maharashtra.gov.in) वर ऑनलाइन अर्ज करा.
- **स्रोत: राष्ट्रीय कृषी विकास योजना (RKVY)**

---

### 3. **शेतीच्या अनुपयोगी बांधकामांसाठी शेती अवकाश आर्थिक फंड (AIF)**  
**केंद्र सरकारची योजना**

- **मुख्य फायदा**: शेतीच्या उत्पादनानंतरच्या सुविधांसाठी (जसे की भांडी, स्टोरेज, बांधकाम) बँक ऋणावर 3% व्याज सबसिडी आणि क्रेडिट गारंटी कव्हर.
- **महत्त्वाचे**: ऋण रक्कम रु. 2 कोटीपर्यंत आहे.
- **अर्ज कसा करावा**: बँकेकडून स्वीकृत योजनेसह अर्ज करा.
- **स्रोत: शेती अवकाश आर्थिक फंड (AIF)**

---

### 4. **प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधी (PM-KISAN)**  
**केंद्र सरकारची योजना**

- **मुख्य फायदा**: वार्षिक ₹6,000 (तीन भागांमध्ये) शेतकऱ्यांच्या बँक खात्यात जमा करणे.
- **पात्रता**: शेतीची जमीन असलेले शेतकरी कुटुंब.
- **अर्ज कसा करावा**: [pmkisan.gov.in](https://pmkisan.gov.in) वर ऑनलाइन अर्ज करा.
- **स्रोत: प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधी (PM-KISAN)**

---

### 5. **नामो शेतकरी महासम्मान निधी (NSMNY)**  
**केंद्र सरकारची योजना**

- **मुख्य फायदा**: PM-KISAN योजनेतील लाभार्थ्यांना आणखी ₹6,000 वार्षिक अतिरिक्त सहाय्य.
- **पात्रता**: PM-KISAN योजनेतील लाभार्थी असणे आवश्यक.
- **अर्ज कसा करावा**: अर्ज करण्याची गरज नाही – PM-KISAN लाभार्थी असल्यास स्वयंचलित लाभ मिळतो.
- **स्रोत: नामो शेतकरी महासम्मान निधी (NSMNY)**

---

### 6. **प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा योजना (PMFBY)**  
**केंद्र सरकारची योजना**

- **मुख्य फायदा**: वादळ, आपत्ती, कीटक आणि रोगामुळे उत्पादन घटल्यास आर्थिक सहाय्य.
- **पात्रता**: निर्धारित पिकांची शेती करणारे शेतकरी.
- **अर्ज कसा करावा**: [www.pmfby.gov.in](https://www.pmfby.gov.in) वर ऑनलाइन अर्ज करा.
- **स्रोत: प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा योजना (PMFBY)**

---

### ✅ शेतकऱ्यांसाठी शिफारस:
तुम्ही **NDKSP – सेंद्रिय उत्पादन एकक** योजनेचा लाभ घेऊन वर्मीकॉम्पोस्ट आणि नाडेप कॉम्पोस्ट तयार करू शकता. यामुळे तुमच्या शेतीत रासायनिक खतांचा वापर कमी करून जैविक शेतीची व्यवस्था करता येईल.

तुम्ही **PM-KISAN** आणि **NSMNY** योजनांचा लाभ घेऊन वार्षिक आर्थिक सहाय्य मिळवू शकता.

---

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**  
कृपया आपल्या जमीन आणि शेतकऱ्यांच्या पात्रतेनुसार योजना निवडा आणि अर्ज करा. आवश्यक असल्यास तुमच्या जवळच्या **कृषी विज्ञान केंद्र (KVK)** किंवा **कृषी अधिकारी** यांच्याशी संपर्क साधा.  

**तुम्हाला आणखी कोणती माहिती हवी आहे?** (उदा. वर्मीकॉम्पोस्ट कसे तयार करायचे?)

*Id*:
65

*Scheme Code*:
mahadbt-baksy

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring
5. Electricity Connection
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)
9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. 2. Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Main Component*:
Organic Production Unit

*Sub Component*:
1. Vermicompost Production Unit 
2. NADEP Compost Production Unit

*Introduction*:
Under the organic farming system, conserving nature, reducing crop production costs, and increasing the use of alternative organic and biological inputs for hazardous chemicals like chemical fertilizers, pesticides, herbicides, and hormones is the need of the hour. Vermicompost is made from farm waste, plant-based materials, and cow dung by earthworms. Vermicompost contains various bacteria, enzymes, vitamins, and other useful chemicals, which have a positive effect on plant growth. 
Similarly, processing farm waste through composting results in the decomposition of its organic matter through biological methods by microorganisms and earthworms, producing excellent humus-like organic compost. If this compost is used extensively in the fields, it will significantly improve soil health and greatly boost agricultural production. It is the need of the hour to prepare organic manure from all plant-based materials generated in the field and return it to the field. Organic manure improves soil texture and water retention capacity, ensuring an adequate supply of nutrients. The soil remains friable, which keeps it aerated. It helps in the growth of beneficial microorganisms in the farm. 
In this regard, considering the above matter, it is proposed to implement the Vermicompost Production Unit and NADEP Compost Production Unit as individual benefit components.

*Benefits*:
1.To enable small and marginal farmers in the village clusters included in the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp to adapt to the situation arising from climate change.
2. To produce nutritious food grains.
3. To practice agriculture by making proper use of natural elements without harming them.
4. To increase soil fertility and maintain it for a long time.
5. To reuse local resources in agriculture.
6. To reduce the cost of agricultural production and increase the net income of the farmer.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have received benefits from any other scheme for this component will not receive benefits again under this scheme.
2. After the unit is established, the benefit will be given to farmers who have at least two large livestock (cows, buffaloes, or bullocks) available to ensure its proper functioning.
3. The benefits of this component under the project will be available to beneficiaries who own up to 5.00 hectares of land.

*Required Documents*:
1. If the applicant is a person with disability, a disability certificate should be provided.
2. If the applicant belongs to the Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes category, evidence related to that.
3. If the applicant is a joint account holder, a consent letter from the other account holders shall be submitted.

*Application Process*:
The NDKSP DBT Portal has been created with the following objectives - 
DBT System for accepting and processing subsidy applications received from farmers. Through this system, farmers can directly login and apply for financial assistance under scheme and disbursement of funds happen directly to the Aadhaar linked account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. There is no need for farmer to visit a government office to apply for subsidy or receive disbursed funds. Also, farmers can track and monitor their applications in real time which shows transparency in NDKSP operations. This system facilitates NDKSP to perform its approval process in 100% paperless manner which eliminates intermediaries and establishes credibility. 
To avail the benefits of the components under the project, the beneficiary (farmer) must directly login on the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system using their Farmer ID. After login, the beneficiary becomes eligible to receive the project benefits. Additionally, it is mandatory for the beneficiary to link their Aadhaar number with their bank account so that the benefit amount can be directly transferred to their personal bank account.
The following farmer attributes need to be entered in the Portal: 
Farmer Attributes: (Essential): 
State, District, Sub-District/Block, Village, Farmer Name, Type of Identity  Farmer ID for landholder farmer is essential, Gender, Category, land cosent letter for joint landholders. 
Farmer Login and application Module:

a) First, download and install the "Mahavistaar-AI Application" from the "Google Play Store" on your mobile.
b) After entering the application, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, click the "DBT" tab at the bottom right of the Dashboard screen.
d) Upon clicking, click the "NDKSP (PoCRA)" tab.
e) To avail benefits for various items under individual components, click the "Click Here" link at the end of this screen to apply.
f) Following this, your NDKSP (PoCRA) project dashboard screen will be available.
g) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.
Step 2: Farmer Login and application Process through the "Project's DBT Web Portal"
a) Visit to "https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications" NDKSP 2.0 website
b) After entering the webpage of Farmer login, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, dashboard screen will be available.
d) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.

2. The scheme is  optional for Loanee & Non-loanee farmers.

question: लहान शेतकऱ्यांसाठी कोणत्या योजनांमध्ये अनुदान जास्त मिळते?
answer:
लहान शेतकऱ्यांसाठी सर्वाधिक अनुदान मिळणाऱ्या योजना खालीलप्रमाणे आहेत. आपल्या शेतीच्या माहितीनुसार, आपण या योजनांमध्ये अर्ज करू शकता:

---

### 1. **बाऊसाहेब फुंडकर हॉर्टिकल्चर प्लांटेशन योजना (Bhausaheb Fundkar Horticulture Plantation Scheme)**  
**प्रकार:** राज्य योजना  
**अनुदान:** 100%  
**विवरण:** आपल्या शेतात फळे, लिंबू, आंबा, अंजीर, आम्ला, कोकोनट, जामुन, कागजी लिंबू, आदी फळांची लागवड करण्यासाठी 100% अनुदान मिळते.  
**लाभार्थी:** सर्व शेतकरी  
**अर्ज करण्यासाठी तयारी:**  
- 7/12 आणि 8A अपडेट करणे  
- आधार कार्ड आणि बँक खाते लिंक करणे  
- ऑनलाइन अर्ज करण्यासाठी महाडीबीटी पोर्टल वापरा: [https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in](https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in)  

---

### 2. **बिर्सा मुंडा शेतकरी क्रांती योजना (Birsa Munda Krushi Kranti Yojna - BMKKY)**  
**प्रकार:** राज्य योजना (अनुदान मिळणाऱ्या गटासाठी)  
**अनुदान:** जुनी बावली, नवीन बावली, पाइप, ड्रिप आणि स्प्रिंकलर इरिगेशन, सौर पंप, पंप सेट यांसाठी अनुदान  
**लाभार्थी:** आदिवासी शेतकरी (ST)  
**विशेष:** जुन्या बावलीच्या दुरुस्तीसाठी ₹1,00,000, नवीन बावलीसाठी ₹4,00,000 अनुदान  
**अर्ज करण्यासाठी तयारी:**  
- आदिवासी जातीचा दाखला  
- 7/12 आणि 8A अपडेट करणे  
- ऑनलाइन अर्ज करण्यासाठी महाडीबीटी पोर्टल वापरा: [https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in](https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in)  

---

### 3. **नामो शेतकरी महासमन निधी (Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi - NSMNY)**  
**प्रकार:** केंद्रीय योजना  
**अनुदान:** ₹6,000 वार्षिक (3 टप्प्यांत)  
**लाभार्थी:** PM-KISAN योजनेत नोंदणी केलेले शेतकरी  
**विशेष:** PM-KISAN योजनेच्या अनुदानाशिवाय आणखी अनुदान मिळते.  
**अर्ज करण्यासाठी तयारी:**  
- PM-KISAN योजनेत नोंदणी केलेले असल्यास अर्ज करण्याची आवश्यकता नाही.  
- ऑनलाइन अर्ज करण्यासाठी: [https://pmkisan.gov.in](https://pmkisan.gov.in)  

---

### 4. **प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधी (PM-KISAN)**  
**प्रकार:** केंद्रीय योजना  
**अनुदान:** ₹6,000 वार्षिक (3 टप्प्यांत)  
**लाभार्थी:** लहान आणि मागास शेतकरी (0.20 ते 6 हेक्टर शेतीचे मालक)  
**विशेष:** आधार कार्ड, बँक खाते आणि 7/12 लिंक केलेले असल्यास अर्ज करता येतो.  
**अर्ज करण्यासाठी तयारी:**  
- ऑनलाइन अर्ज करण्यासाठी: [https://pmkisan.gov.in](https://pmkisan.gov.in)  

---

### 5. **पीएम-आरकेव्ही-पर ड्रॉप मोर क्रॉप (PM-RKVY-Per Drop More Crop)**  
**प्रकार:** केंद्रीय योजना  
**अनुदान:**  
- लहान आणि मागास शेतकरी: 55%  
- इतर शेतकरी: 45%  
**लाभार्थी:** ड्रिप आणि स्प्रिंकलर इरिगेशन सिस्टमसाठी  
**विशेष:** शेतीच्या आकारानुसार अनुदान मिळते (अधिकतम 5 हेक्टर).  
**अर्ज करण्यासाठी तयारी:**  
- ऑनलाइन अर्ज करण्यासाठी: [https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in](https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in)  

---

### 6. **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प (NDKSP) - विविध योजना**  
**प्रकार:** राज्य योजना (पोकरा गावांसाठी)  
**अनुदान:** 50% ते 100%  
**लाभार्थी:** शेतकरी आणि लहान उद्योजक  
**विशेष:**  
- ड्रिप इरिगेशन, स्प्रिंकलर, बावली लाइनिंग, फार्म पॉन्ड, फलोत्पादन, गोठा, गाय, मधुमक्खी, अंडी आदीसाठी अनुदान.  
**अर्ज करण्यासाठी तयारी:**  
- ऑनलाइन अर्ज करण्यासाठी: [https://mahapocra.gov.in](https://mahapocra.gov.in)  

---

### ✅ **आपल्या शेतीच्या माहितीनुसार आपल्याला खालील योजनांचा लाभ मिळू शकतो:**
- **बाऊसाहेब फुंडकर हॉर्टिकल्चर प्लांटेशन योजना** (100% अनुदान)
